content.comment_body: Good morning everyone, I have set up a [product_name] with a [product_name] website, and when accessing it via VPN, it continuously stays on the loading screen. Has anyone else experienced this? Is there a way to make it load faster? The [product_name] file is only 2 MB and I'm using the [product_name] module. Thanks, [user_name]
Hi [user_name], Which [version_no] of [product_name] are you using? You mentioned it keeps loading—does it ever finish loading and establish a connection?
[version_no]. The page never finishes loading, though the GUI indicates it is connected.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter problems accessing the [product_name] web interface remotely via VPN on a [version_no] device with a [product_name] module. The site sticks on a loading screen, despite the GUI showing a connected status. Although the file size is only 2 MB, accessing over VPN significantly affects performance, which leads to concerns about the effectiveness and reliability of remote access.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the [product_name] website to load quickly and reliably through VPN, providing a similar experience to local access.
